caption: The drawing is a monochromatic line illustration on a beige background, depicting the components and details of a grandfather clock. On the left side, there is a full frontal view of the clock, showing a rectangular base, a tall body, and a decorative top section with curved edges, finials, and a small bird or eagle figure. At the upper part of the clock, the face displays Roman numerals and clock hands pointing at 8:09. To the right of the frontal view, there is a side view of the clock case, showing its depth and additional architectural detailing. Between these two primary views are several separate detailed components: a decorative metal keyhole plate, a large ornate pendulum bob with an eagle figure perched on its top, and two clock hands depicted in greater detail. The illustration is composed solely of black lines without any shading or color variation, and all elements are presented in a precise, technical style on the plain background.
title: Clock
